names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 24 mai, «Sfânta Muceniță Marciana».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Μαΐου, which names her inside Meletius's company as «Μαρκιανή», with the rank word left off; the life page's own head line for her reads «Αγια Μαρκιανη».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 мая ст. ст. — «Мчч. Мелетия Стратилата, Стефана , Иоанна , Серапиона египтянина, Каллиника волхва, Феодора и Фавста , и с ними 1218 воинов с женами и детьми (ок. 218).»

attestations.note: SHE IS NOT ON THE DAY’S OWN LINE AND HAS NO `name:` LINK: the line names seven and then «и с ними 1218 воинов с женами и детьми», and she is one of them, enumerated by name in the prose of the day’s own life page, life1135. She stands in the first of the two lists the calendar’s life page gives of the company’s members, the women and children: «Из пострадавших жен и детей известны имена святых мучениц Маркианы, Сосанны, Палладии, младенцев Кириака и Христиана.» That list is the calendar’s own enumeration of the company it heads, so this folder is kept on this day by the ruling that a synaxis enumerating its members is one folder per member. NO `ru` NAME FORM WAS STORED, DELIBERATELY. The calendar prints this name nowhere but inside that list, in the genitive and as a bare forename — «Маркианы» — with no name page, no epithet and no surname anywhere on the day. A nominative reconstructed from a genitive is something a reader made, not something the calendar printed (BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2), and a bare forename of this kind would in several of these fifteen cases widen a fold that stands unread in the gate. The declined form is recorded here instead and the author can promote it. `dates` was written where there was none: the reign the calendar prints for the whole company, «в царствование римского императора Антонина Гелиогобала (218–222)», which is the interval the rest of this company already carries. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 mai — «Sfânta Muceniță Marciana»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Μελέτιος ο στρατηλάτης και οι συν αυτώ Μάρτυρες … Μαρκιανή …»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day on which doxologia.ro prints the bare line «Sfânta Muceniță Marciana» that this folder was made from, and it gives her the company and the death the Romanian line withholds: she is one of the three women who believed at the sight of the martyrdom of Meletius the Stratelates's company under Elagabalus, 218 to 222, and her couplet has the three of them killed with wood for not sacrificing to Pallas. **The match is on the day and on the name, which is the whole of what either source gives to match on.** No hymn is printed to her.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

death.note: The folder had no `dates` object at all. The reign the Russian calendar prints for the whole company, «в царствование римского императора Антонина Гелиогобала (218–222)», with the day line’s «(ок. 218)» inside it; it is the interval the other folders of this company already carry. No year of birth appears anywhere and none was inferred.
